direction.camera: Guide attention with magazine spread; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: give one image and one serif headline unequal visual weight; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with expressive serif; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with thin rule.
direction.lighting: soft editorial studio; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: warm paper and fine ink; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around editorial pause; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use magazine spread,expressive serif,generous margin,large image,editorial pause,thin rule as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
